name: Yuha Lee
bio: Yuha Lee (hangul: 이유하, RR: I Yu-ha) is a South Korean actress active in independent cinema, with experience in both South Korea and Japan. She has appeared in several auteur films, including Ghost Mask: Scar, in which she played a leading role, as well as Korean productions such as Duck Town and A Day. Her career blends genre films and low‑budget projects.
